confirmation_target.exploratory_pattern: A two-worker 0/37 collapse at layer 5, full recovery, and a one-worker 0/37 terminal collapse at layer 10 while references grew from 3 to 27.
confirmation_target.independence: This full depth-10 configuration and all thresholds were frozen before any outcome from the new confirmation run existed.

local_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: The MiniSWE inference returns a snapshot without an infrastructure error.
local_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: The trajectory contains at least three environment actions with return code 0.
local_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains a frozen success marker.
local_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every output satisfying all conditions is appended permanently regardless of blinded external score.
local_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: External Core and all-test scores are removed from locally accepted treatment references.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the same three frozen diverse 4/4 Core sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: Append every locally accepted output from every completed layer.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 4/4 Core, 34/37 overall, with the frozen hash.
validity_gates.local_proxy_activation: At least two layer-1 outputs are locally accepted and proxy fields are recorded for every worker.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No locally accepted treatment reference delivered downstream contains its external score.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Matching no-transfer layer-5 mean is 1.0 Core and 0.9189 overall.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 4, total tests 37, and the frozen hash.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_all_test: Treatment layer-10 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below matching no-transfer layer-5 mean 0.9189.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_all_test: Treatment all-test score falls by at least 0.15 from its layer-1-to-layer-9 peak to layer 10.
degradation_criteria.core_support: Treatment layer-10 mean Core is below 0.80 or at least one layer-10 worker is 0/4.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two post-layer-1 all-test transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40 and the terminal score remains below 0.75.
degradation_criteria.tail_risk: At least one layer-10 worker scores 0/37.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-10 reference count reaches at least 18 and worker input tokens are at least 5.0x matching no transfer.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, core-support, curve-shape, tail-risk, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.confirm: If all requirements pass, treat the degradation curve as confirmed for Kimi-K2.6 and run two additional independent repeats plus a second model.
decision_rule.partial: If validity, primary, within-arm, tail-risk, and complexity pass but curve shape misses, record a confirmed terminal degradation effect without claiming a progressive curve.
decision_rule.falsify: If validity passes but primary or within-arm is non-negative, reject replication of the exploratory pattern.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if local proxy activation, recipient blinding, target consistency, or integrity fails.
